name: Garren, Campanero de Porcelana
design: Same stocky armored male jailer Garren as the reference, fully covered head with barred faceguard and short crest, chain weapon attached to hand and waist. SUBSTANTIALLY NEW SKIN: sculpted ivory porcelain armor with restrained cobalt glaze patterns, navy padded undersuit, a large brass bell-shaped shoulder pauldron, bell clapper chain ending in a small heavy cracked ceramic bell instead of a shackle. Helmet rebuilt as rounded porcelain bell-like crown with narrow barred visor, not the original metal plating. Boots and gauntlets ceramic, attached chain loops. No tower shield, no masonry, no turret. Palette ivory/navy/cobalt/old brass with warm shadow planes. Attack poses swing the connected bell chain; cast poses pull the hand chain upward; ultimate poses raise bell chain overhead.

name: Farolero, Guardavía de Medianoche
design: Same compact elderly male lantern keeper from reference, visible lined light-skinned face, short grey beard and grey hair. SUBSTANTIALLY NEW SKIN: navy railway conductor cap (no hood), tailored long midnight-blue railway greatcoat with ochre brass buttons and reddish scarf, sturdy coal-black boots, leather ticket satchel on hip. Carries a long walking staff with an attached warm amber railway signal lantern, rectangular glass cage with red trim. Small attached coal shovel at belt. Keep live flame amber, not electric cyan. No glowing VFX, no particles. Palette navy/ochre/russet/cream. Attack poses jab staff; cast poses hold lantern forward; ultimate poses lift lantern staff above shoulder.

name: Morwen, Herbolaria de Escarcha
design: Same female alchemist Morwen from reference, light skin, dark brown shoulder-length hair, large curious eyes. SUBSTANTIALLY NEW SKIN: quilted pale blue apothecary winter coat with ivory fur collar and small hood folded down (no wizard hat and no mushroom hat), warm ivory ear-wrap band, dark plum leggings and boots, large medicine satchel with visible attached angular frosted-glass flasks and corks, one short frosted glass retort held in hand. A dark blue apron with pocket botanical sprigs. No barrel, no wineglass, no mushroom anatomy, no floating particles, no painted magic. Palette icy blue/ivory/plum/dark navy/glass mint accent. Attack poses extend retort to pour; cast poses carefully mix held retort with attached flask; ultimate poses lift two held flasks.

name: Dáriel, Luthier de los Autómatas
design: Same young adult male musician Dariel from reference, light skin, short messy brown hair, confident elegant expression. SUBSTANTIALLY NEW SKIN: cream linen artisan shirt with rolled sleeves, deep green leather long work apron, ochre gloves, dark trousers, brass-toed boots; attached wooden mechanical violin on back with visible wind-up key, compact musical tuning-fork tool held in right hand and a small instrument case on hip. No theatrical mask, no top hat, no conductor tailcoat, no goggles, no mushroom or lantern. Palette cream/forest green/warm wood/old brass/dark navy. Attack poses point and swing tuning tool; cast poses turn attached violin key; ultimate poses raise tuning fork while other hand braces violin strap.
